USB-C cable bridge (no Wi-Fi needed)

Plug the USB-C cable, enable USB tethering (button above), then on the laptop browse the address above.

Developers: a laptop with adb tools can skip tethering entirely:

adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080
→ then open http://127.0.0.1:8080 on the laptop.
Copy adb reverse command

How to connect virtually from another phone

1. Turn on Wi-Fi Hotspot on this phone (or connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi network). 2. Connect your other phone to this phone\'s Hotspot. 3. Open Chrome or Safari on the other phone: scan the QR code, or type the short URL above and the 6-digit code. 4. Chat with GOD-AI with instant smart model routing, speak by voice, and browse/edit phone workspace files with zero install!
